_comment: Line-parsing rules for the log_tail module (modules/bdg/desktop/log_tail). Copy this file (it lands per-session at res/bdg/desktop/log_tail/patterns.json) and edit it to add support for your own log format -- see log_line_parser.hpp for the exact schema and matching rules.

line_formats.name: docker_timestamps
line_formats.description: `docker logs --timestamps` / `docker compose logs -t`: RFC3339 nanosecond timestamp followed by the log message.

line_formats.name: syslog_rfc3164
line_formats.description: Classic syslog: 'Mon dd hh:mm:ss host process[pid]: message'.

line_formats.name: python_logging
line_formats.description: Python `logging` default format: 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss,ms - logger - LEVEL - message'.

line_formats.name: iso8601_level
line_formats.description: ISO-8601 timestamp followed by a bracketed or bare severity word, e.g. '2024-01-15T10:23:45Z [ERROR] message' or '2024-01-15 10:23:45,001 WARN message'.

line_formats.name: bracket_level
line_formats.description: No timestamp, bracketed severity prefix: '[ERROR] message'.

line_formats.name: level_prefixed
line_formats.description: No timestamp, bare severity prefix: 'ERROR: message'.

line_formats.name: fallback
line_formats.description: Matches any line unchanged. Must stay last -- line_formats are tried in order and the first match wins.
